# Slyde More [![Fabric Loader](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-lightyellow?logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://fabricmc.net) [![Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/Enviroment-Client-purple)](#) [![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/No-Eul/SlydeMore)](https://github.com/No-Eul/SlydeMore/blob/main/LICENSE.txt) [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/No-Eul/SlydeMore)](https://github.com/No-Eul/SlydeMore/releases/latest)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/slyde-more?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/slyde-more) [![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/No-Eul/SlydeMore/total?logo=github)](https://github.com/No-Eul/SlydeMore/releases)
[](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/NoEul) Slyde More 是一款 Fabric 模組，在使用 [Slyde](https://modrinth.com/mod/slyde) 模組時，允許拖曳滑桿超出螢幕寬度限制。
## 依賴項 ### 必要條件 * [Minecraft](https://www.minecraft.net) (遊戲) * [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net) (模組載入器) ### 建議 * [Slyde](https://modrinth.com/mod/slyde) (模組) ### 衝突 * [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) `<0.7.0+mc1.21.9` ## 備註 * 模組檔案名稱表示模組名稱、載入器和版本： * `(模組名稱)-(模組版本)+mc(構建的 Minecraft 版本)+(模組載入器).jar` * 例如：`SlydeMore-1.0.0+mc1.21.1+fabric.jar`
